description: A sophisticated, architecturally refined dining area with a distinctly Japanese-Scandinavian minimalist character. The dining table is a natural pale oak oval on simple tapered legs, set just inside the lower frame edge; white minimalist dining chairs with simple flat backs are partially visible at the table edge. The overall material palette — warm plaster, dark wood slats, amber glass — is deeply composed and intentional, with a spa-like luxury. Warm diffused ambient light fills the space from the coved ceiling above and the amber glass partition on the right. Camera is at standing eye-level, looking upward at a mild pitch toward the ceiling cove and the suspended elements below it, capturing the architectural ceiling detail as the compositional focus of the frame.
